Tax Sale for Huge Real Estate Discounts in Macomb County, Michigan

Macomb County, Michigan’s Tax Foreclosure Sale offers an incredible opportunity to invest in real estate at deeply discounted prices. The online auctions make it convenient to bid on properties from anywhere, with discounts ranging from 40% to 90% off.

Key Details and Links for Macomb County Tax Sale Auction

Auction Process in Macomb County

Registration:
Participants must first register on the Zeus Auction website and then specifically for the Macomb County auction. Registration deadlines are just the day before each sale starts.

Auction Dates:
The auctions run from the third Tuesday in July to the first Tuesday in November, with the Minimum Bid Sale in September and the No-Minimum Bid Sale in October.

Bidding in Macomb County:
Bidders compete in the auction, and the county may bundle properties for sale. You must meet or exceed the minimum bid to win. Payment deadlines are strict and specified payment methods streamline the transaction process.

Property Conditions:
Buyers must inspect properties “as-is” to ensure they meet investment needs. The tax foreclosure process typically clears most liens.

Important Points

  • Properties sold at auction are offered first to the state, local community, and county.
  • Prospective buyers must conduct their own research and inspections to determine the suitability of properties.
  • Properties are sold with no guarantees about their condition, access, or usability.

Pro Tips for Investors in Macomb County

  • Research Thoroughly: Understand local laws and the auction process by visiting the Macomb County Treasurer’s Office website.
  • Inspect Properties: Personally inspect the properties to avoid surprises after purchase.
  • Prepare Financially: Ensure you have the necessary funds ready to meet payment deadlines if you win a bid.

Useful Links

  • County Treasurer’s Office
  • County Auction and Claims Information
  • Zeus Auction Site

By participating in the Macomb County Tax Foreclosure Sale, you have the chance to acquire valuable properties at a fraction of their market value. This is an excellent opportunity for savvy investors looking to expand their real estate portfolio.

FAQs

What types of properties are available in the Macomb County Tax Foreclosure Sale?

Properties range from residential to commercial, and they are sold “as-is.” It’s crucial to research each property thoroughly before bidding.

How do I register for the Macomb County auction?

You must register on the Zeus Auction website and then specifically for the Macomb County auction. Registration deadlines are the day before each sale starts.

What are the payment options for winning bids?

Payment methods are specified during registration and typically include cash, cashier’s check, or wire transfer. They do not accept personal and business checks, money orders, or charge cards.

For more detailed information, please visit the County Treasurer’s Office and the Zeus Auction Site​.
